title: campanula rupestris f. breueri
intro: Campanula rupestris f. breueri, commonly known as alpine bellflower, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Campanula rupestris f. breueri include reducing inflammation, soothing skin irritations, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal value.
